fact_text: The government released 200 billion PKR for the power sector's circular debt after an ECC meeting and the circular debt plan.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Circular Debt Payment's Impact PSX Market Update' (YouTube, 2023-12-29)

fact_text: The analyst called the 200 billion PKR release a good start but small against the scale of the circular debt problem.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Circular Debt Payment's Impact PSX Market Update' (YouTube, 2023-12-29)

fact_text: A figure of about 400 billion PKR for the circular debt was cited in the discussion, and the analyst said the government would need to set it off.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Circular Debt Payment's Impact PSX Market Update' (YouTube, 2023-12-29)

fact_text: PPL's receivables from the circular debt payments flow through gas transmission and distribution companies such as SNGPL and SSGC.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Circular Debt Payment's Impact PSX Market Update' (YouTube, 2023-12-29)

fact_text: The analyst questioned why a gas producer with falling output would pay a one-time dividend.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Circular Debt Payment's Impact PSX Market Update' (YouTube, 2023-12-29)

fact_text: Mari's gas production was about 918 mmcfd daily, and the analyst said it has been larger than other fields' output for several years.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Circular Debt Payment's Impact PSX Market Update' (YouTube, 2023-12-29)

fact_text: Pakistan's national daily gas production was about 3,000 mmcfd, which the analyst said is well below domestic demand.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Circular Debt Payment's Impact PSX Market Update' (YouTube, 2023-12-29)

fact_text: OGDC and PPL production has trended down for years because large older fields such as Sui, Qadirpur and Kandkot have declined, the analyst said.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Circular Debt Payment's Impact PSX Market Update' (YouTube, 2023-12-29)

fact_text: Pakistan imports RLNG, and the expensive gas that results is supplied to industrial and commercial users, so the analyst wanted domestic gas output to rise.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Circular Debt Payment's Impact PSX Market Update' (YouTube, 2023-12-29)
